description: Road Transport Energy Consumption, Borough is a dataset listed in London Datastore, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Department for Business, Energy & Industrial Strategy (BEIS). Estimates of road transport consumption statistics for fuels used in road transport. (1) Personal travel includes buses, diesel cars, petrol cars and motorcycles. (2) Freight includes HGV, diesel LGV and petrol LGV. The UK total excludes motorcycles in Northern Ireland. Coverage: Department for Business, Energy & Industrial Strategy (BEIS). The publisher named on the listing is Department for Business, Energy & Industrial Strategy (BEIS). Its keywords include cars, motorcycle, road, transport, bus, freight. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Open Government Licence v2. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-london-datastore.
